design:
## Design tests

After the bench, the new drawings were read blind in whole test scenes among other events (`vision/design_tests_v027.md`, six pictures, three readers). The broom and a rake stood in one picture, "sweeping a small pile of orange, yellow and red leaves with a straw broom" beside "raking a small pile of green and brown leaves". The walker with the book was "not looking where they are going". The soaked box was read inference and all, "so whatever is inside looks likely to get ruined", and the sitter off the path as "impossible". No beard read as a mask or a strap in these six, though the screen later found two. Two small fixes came out of them and were not read again: a shadow under a ball in a walker's way ("it looks slightly as if it is floating"), and a seated adult's feet closer in, as the thigh is shorter ("he looks as if he is sliding"). The hose still read as "a pole or stand" at first, and was left.
intro: The twenty-fourth screen read all 67 pictures, the set's 21 and 46 probes: 743 of 756 scored items had full marks, and none was misread. The gate recovered: 63 of the 64 templates pass, against 59, and all five of v0.26's failures pass. `sweep` went from 0.67 to 1.00, with no reader saying rake, and `ice_cream` to 1.00 in 13 pictures. How much of that is the drawings is not cleanly separated: `photo` recovered without being changed, and the v0.9 retest put the gate's reader variance at about five templates. The one failure, `dog_begs` at 0.89, is on a drawing this release did not change, as readers were unsure whose food the dog wants. Readers' remarks per picture went the other way, up 10% from 5.27 to 5.81, across all the readers. Remarks on hidden faces fell by half, the main aim of the release, while remarks on shadows and on marks on a face rose. The shorter legs, which looked good on a small bench sample, did not reduce the remarks on thin figures in whole pictures. And the tier-4 playground was not found by search at all: 219 free seeds placed nothing, so it uses the v0.26 picture's template set.
screen:
Across all 67 pictures 743 of 756 scored items had full marks. Five had half marks, eight were missed, and none was misread. The eight missed items are all things in probes, six "a few white clouds" and two "there is a tree", and one reader, of pictures 9 to 16, names no cloud and no sun in any of its eight pictures, which accounts for seven of them. The half marks are on meaning: the dog that begs, twice ("could be hers, begging from her bag, or could be doing its own trick"); the trip, once ("headed roughly past it"); the teenager with the fork ("I am not sure what the boy is doing with it"); and the dog at the door ("or could just be an odd pose"). The set's headline is all items 0.993 (0.988 in v0.26), with things and contradictions at 1.00, actions at 0.996 and inferences at 0.950, on three half marks.

**Remarks went up, 389 against 353.** They are spread across the readers, on the same model and prompts as v0.26, so this release did not make the pictures read as cleaner in general. `vision/remark_topics.py` sorts them roughly by keyword. A face hidden or hard to read fell from 22 pictures to 10, the release's main change. Shadows rose from 13 to 20 with nothing changed ("a very wide oval, much wider than the puppy"), and marks on a face from 4 to 9, as faces are more on view ("dark marks around her nose and mouth"). Thin or long bodies went from 6 to 8, where the bench had suggested a fall: whole pictures did not confirm that small bench sample. Water drawn solid went from 2 to 0 with nothing changed, which shows the size of this count's noise.
redrawn: `sweep` and `ice_cream` read in full on their redraws. `about_to_trip` rose with the lifted heel and the turned head, its meaning item from 0.67 to 0.88, and was offered in all four pictures, though the obstacle's line still draws remarks. `sprinkler_package` read in full with its short drips and no crate. `photo` was not changed and read in full, as the v0.26 list guessed. `dog_begs` is the one failure, and it read in full in v0.26 on the same drawing, so placement is the first thing to try.
gate: Every template was screened in at least three pictures (54 in three, 6 in four, 1 in five, 2 in six, 1 in thirteen), and 63 of 64 pass, up from 59. `dog_begs` fails on two half marks in three pictures, and read in full where the dog sits right beside the eater. The v0.9 retest put the gate's reader variance at about five templates between screens, about the size of this recovery, so it is good news without being a measure of what the drawings gained. The gate is a filter, and the pilot with people is the test of difficulty.
inspection: Building and inspecting the set and the probes found one thing this release could not search its way past. The tier-4 garden placed again on its v0.26 seed, the park took 24 failed seeds and the street 14, each across three searches side by side, and the tier-3 street one search seed past its showcase seed. The tier-4 playground did not come at all: 219 free seeds across six searches placed nothing. The same 24 seeds under revisions 23, 24 and 25 failed with almost the same counts (`about_to_trip` named 378, 379 and 379 times), so the rules added since v0.25 are not the cause. The template sets that placed in v0.24, v0.25 and v0.26, forced, each placed within seconds on one of two seed lists, so the room is not the cause either: the planner keeps drawing sets of nine events that cannot fit this setting. Why that got worse after v0.25 is still not shown, and `vision/flaws_v027.md` has what to test next. This release's tier-4 playground is the v0.26 picture's template set, forced (`regen.forced`), so it repeats v0.26's events. The tier-4 isomorph took 123 failed attempts (676 in v0.26). The set's isomorphs are two at tier 2, two at tier 3 and one at tier 4. All 67 records rebuild identical to the pixel.
calib: The trip's cue salience moved by -0.034 and the heavy seesaw's by +0.032, the two largest, with the figures' new heads and legs; 39 fields in 14 templates moved by 0.002 or more.
